tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /jag chings ra ru ma'i gsal byed bzhugs so// na mo gu ru arya ta ra ye/ 'dir bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ja mang po klu pa brtson 'grus grags la rje btsun ma sgrol mas dngos su gnang ba'i jag chings ra ru ma'i lo rgyus dang bcas bsham ni gzhung du gsal/ 'dir sgrub tshul khol 'don du byed na/ rang gi mdun du lcags slang sogs drag po'i snod kyi nang liṅga bzhag yang snod gzhan cig tu sātstsha/ yungs dkar/ rde'u dkar nag ro ras sam ras nag rtsid skud ra ru la cha rnams bshams la/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum/ tshad med bzhi/ swā bhā wa'i sngags kyis bdag dang snod bcud stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las sna tshogs padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba dang 'dab ma rnams la a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re/ dbus su rang nyid skad cig gis seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma dang / phyogs mtshams brgyad du seng ge glang chen/ me/ chom rkun/ dug sbrul/ brtson khang / chu dang 'byung po'i gdon rnams las skyob pa'i rje btsun ma sgrol ma ste thams cad kyang sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon utpala'i yu ba thugs kar bzung nas snyan gyi thad sor kha phye ba/ zhabs g.yas brkyangs/ g.yon bskums/ ral pa'i thor cog dang nu 'bur zung gis mdzes pa/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas seng ldeng nags kyi sgrol ma la 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba oṃ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥganyis su med par thim/ oṃ arghaṃ/ pā dyaṃ/ puṣpe/ dhu pe/ a ཱlo ke/ gandhe/ nai wi dye/ shapta āḥhūm̐/ 'jigs pa chen po brgyad las ni/ /'jig rten thams cad skyob par mdzad/ /kun gyi ma ru gyur pa yi/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swāhā/ brgya'am nyer gcig la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/

ka sha ka sha drag thal drag thal/ snying chod snying chod/ ya ya/ tse tse nan nan/ rbad rbad/ kha la raksha rbad/ snying la raksha rbad/ rus la raksha rbad/ rtsa la raksha rbad/ khrag la raksha rbad/ gzugs phung la raksha rbad/ dran rig la raksha rbad/ dgra bo'i lus ngag yid gsum chings shig stambha ya nan/ dgra jag chom rkun mā ra ya/ rengs rengs/ myogs myogs/ thibs thibs/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas la bden bdar spyi 'gre'i mthar/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis yul dang sgar pa che ge mor gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra jag chom rkun bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba thams cad skad cig thang gcig yud tsam la gzugs dang liṅga 'di la mchis par gyur cig ces dang / dmigs pa ni rang rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyis bskor ba'i thugs ka nas rigs gsum mgon po'i sprul pa gser gyi seng ge dung gi glang chen/ mu men gyi dom rgyags shing khros pa bsam gyis mi khyab pas dgra jag thams cad lug khyu 'ded pa bzhin ded nas mdun gyi liṅga la thim par bsam la/ oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re dgra jag chom rkun che ge mo a karṣa ya dzaḥ zhes dang / 'gugs pa'i stangs ka byed/ de 'dra ba dmigs pa gsal zhing brtan pas lan grangs ci rigs byas la sngags bzla zhing liṅgar dug khrag gis byugs/ skam pa dang / ra ru de lcags kyi khang sgrom du bsam la liṅga bcug pa'i snying gar gri rus de ha raksha sogs sngags zur bris kyis bstum la gri rus kyi nṛ dang snying ga'i nṛ thad khar yong bar byas/ shog lhag rnams liṅga'i steng du bsdus/ ro ras sam/ ras nag gi khud du yungs dkar rdog nyer gcig bstum nas bcug la 'jam dpal gyi sprul pa gser gyi seng ge nyer gcig gis lus mnan par bsgoms la/ ka sha sogs sngags bzla/ yang ras nag gcig tu rdel dkar nyer gcig bstum nas de'i khar bcug la spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa dung glang nyer gcig gis ngag mnan par bsam ste sngags bzla/

yang ras nag gi khud gcig tu rdel nag nyer gcig bstum nas bcug la phyag rdor gyi sprul pa mu men gyi dom nyer gcig gis yid mnan par bsams la sngags bzla/ de'i khar ras nag gis kha phur la rlung rdo rje rgya gram gyis gtams par sgom zhing sngags bzla/ de'i khar sātstsha de rje btsun sgrol ma 'od dpag med kyi cod paṇa can la rnam snang / rin 'byung / mi bskyod pa/ don yod grub pa rnams kyis bskor nas bzhugs par bsams zhing / sgrol ma'i sngags ci nus bzla la rdo shing sogs kha gcod gang rung gi phyi nas la chas bsdams pa'i khar twaṃ yig thel 'byar lta bur byas pa'i ra ru de rtsid skud kyis bcings la nang ngam gur gang rung gi ka bar ra ru'i rtse thur bltas su sgrag la g.yon bskor bya zhing sgrol ma'i gzungs dang gong gi sngags ka sha sogs ci nus bzlas nas stan la 'khod de/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /rje btsun sgrol ma 'grub gyur nas/ /zhes sogs bsngo smon byas la yul du 'chang ba'am/ byes la 'khur ba'am/ gzhan la bskur ba gang byed kyang rang gzhan gyis g.yas bskor gtan nas ma byung bar byed/ gal te g.yas bskor byung na nus pa nyams 'gro bas ra ru'i rdzas phyung la sngar bzhin bsgrub/ jag nyen che sar/ sngags nyer gcig bzlas la ra ru'i kha la phus 'debs pa ma chag par byas pas nges par chom rkun gyi 'tshe ba las skyob par gsungs so/ /zhes jag chings ra ru mar nye bar mkho ba 'di yang sa skya pa kun blos bris pa'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa'o/ 'grul la 'gro ba'i tshe rgyun du nyams len byed na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs nas/ ci nus bzlas/ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ thal mo sbyar te/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun gyi༞ khyad par du yang rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i bka' bden pa dang /

bden pa chen po'i byin brlabs kyis bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra jag chom rkun thams cad phyir bzlog par gyur cig med par gyur cig zhi bar gyur cig zhes thal mo lan gsum brdab pa tshar gsum/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /ces sogs bya'o/ /'di la gzhung las bden bdar thal rdeb ma gsungs kyang / byas pa la 'gal ba gtan nas med de drag sngags kyi 'dogs can yin pas so// //zhes pa'ang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis bris// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ jag chings ra ru ma'i gsal byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
